name: Total Outstanding report based on bills
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "Invoice No",
    customer AS "Customer Name",
    posting_date AS "Posting Date", 
    due_date AS "Due Date", 
    grand_total AS "Invoice Amount", 
    outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding Amount"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice`
WHERE 
    docstatus = 1 AND outstanding_amount > 0
ORDER BY 
    due_date ASC;
report_name: Total Outstanding report based on bills
